author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch the Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2026 to get a glimpse at some of the best student-created content we’ve seen this year. 
All around the world, talented students are honing their Unreal Engine skills on a host of inspiring projects, from hyperreal to anime and everything in between. If you’re a prospective employer looking to grab the cream of the crop, this is your chance to see what the brightest and best are capable of. 

Find out more about Unreal Engine at unrealengine.com, and check out resources for students and educators at unrealengine.com/students-and-schools

#StudentShowcase2026, #UnrealEngine
title: The Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Go behind the scenes with creators from the UEFN Student Bootcamp. Hosts Dan Hutnik and Matthew Zanazzo (Immature Gamer) dive into five student-built Fortnite islands with their creators, exploring custom Verse mechanics, LEGO gameplay systems, and real-world lessons from shipping a live game in UEFN.

If you’re an experienced game dev, artist or educator, apply now for the free UEFN Pro Bootcamp. It’s a free, three-week virtual program for game devs, artists and educators with 3+ years of industry or teaching experience. You get one week of live training on UEFN, Verse and Scene Graph, then two weeks building and publishing your own Fortnite island with support. Free to attend, but you’ll need to commit the time to finish the course and publish your island.
Applications close November 6th.

Apply now: https://airtable.com/appwoLkcnXvS9b7x0/pagkRNaGZ9sjuZnWc/form

Read more: https://www.unrealengine.com/news/uefn-professional-bootcamp-prepare-for-unreal-engine-6
title: UEFN Student Bootcamp Project Showcase | Creating in Fortnite
